files.device.hex: Device descriptor from Linux sysfs; contains string indices, no serial string
files.configuration_high_speed.hex: Active 480 Mbps configuration from Linux sysfs
files.other_speed_full_speed.hex: Standard GET_DESCRIPTOR(OTHER_SPEED_CONFIGURATION), type 7, captured while at high speed
files.hid_report.hex: 267-byte HID report descriptor from the attached device's sysfs hidraw interface

limits: The full-speed bytes describe advertised behavior; no ESP32-to-deck link was measured
These physical descriptors are separate from the pinned upstream encoder fixtures
No image/brightness/output transfers or input key reports are represented by these files
Descriptor power declarations are not current measurements
